{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify sentinel values: -999 is likely missing data
sentinel_value = -999

# Count how many rows have sentinel value
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with sentinel value (-999): {sentinel_count}")

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is sentinel
valid_data = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute mean on valid data
valid_mean = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {valid_mean}")"}
